notes: Accepted violations of the downward-only rule (ARCHITECTURE.md section 2).

io -> crypto: extraction_journal.cpp needs CRC32 (journal record integrity) and RNG (temp names); motw.cpp needs RNG for Zone.Identifier GUIDs. crypto sits above io in the layer diagram but never includes io back, so the edge is one-way and stable.
recovery -> archive: RecoveryWriter reads archive/volume headers to generate external .rev parity volumes (v1.24+); the erasure math itself stays below archive.
